name: vortex
title: Vortex
description: A canvas backdrop of hundreds of short particle streaks that drift on a noise field, leaving glowing tails. The streaks gather in a loose band and keep swirling without end.
use: A dramatic dark section wants a living particle field behind its message or product shot.
avoid: It redraws 700 particles every frame, so it drains battery on phones and never idles.
a11y: Continuous canvas motion with no pause or reduced-motion check; the pulsing glow can also be harsh for photosensitive users. (keyboard: n-a, labels: n-a, reduced motion: not handled)
looks: A black field threaded with hundreds of short glowing streaks in blue, violet and magenta. The streaks cluster in the middle band and curl into loose arcs and loops, bright at their centres and fading at the tips.
behaves: The particles drift and curl continuously along a noise flow, then respawn near the middle so the swirling band never empties. There is no pointer response; the motion runs from load.
customise: Set particleCount, baseHue, speeds and radii, background colour, plus container and content classes. The noise field, glow passes and middle-band spawn are fixed in code.
weight: heavy: 700 particles redrawn every animation frame with two blur passes and a noise sample each.
demo: The demo adds the word 'Vortex' as a centred caption, which is not visible in the frames.
issues: The demo's 'Vortex' caption is missing from every frame.
Canvas is sized to the window, not its container, so it can overflow a small box.
Glow stays a narrow horizontal band, leaving most of the frame empty.
polishWhy: Vivid swirling particle streams with a strong glow; the motion is confined to a narrow middle band.
